records.source: ランゴスタの素材で覆われた{j}頭用装備。火と氷には極端に{j}弱いが、硬い外殻により強固。
records.previous: {j}Head equipment covered in Vespoid materials. It is extremely{j}weak to Fire and Ice, but its hard outer shell makes it sturdy.
records.target: {j}Vespoid head gear; weak to Fire and Ice.{j}Its hard shell still makes it sturdy.

records.source: 街を守護するという騎士の、{j}頭装備の廉価版。羽飾りと特{j}徴的な面頬が人気の一品。
records.previous: A budget version of the{j}head gear worn by knights sworn to guard the city. A popular piece, thanks to its feather plume and distinctive{j}face guard.
records.target: Budget knight's headpiece for city guards.{j}Its plume and distinctive face guard{j}makes it popular.

records.source: 古い壁画に残る、龍をも凌ぐ{j}力を持つ人々の防具に酷似し{j}た頭装備。羽毛のように軽い。
records.previous: Head armor closely resembling the armor of the people in ancient murals, whose power{j}surpassed even dragons.{j}Light as a feather.
records.target: Head armor resembling ancient mural armor,{j}worn by people who surpassed dragons.{j}Light as a feather.

records.source: かぶると雑念が消え去り、目{j}の前の敵を殲滅することしか{j}考えられなくなる恐怖の防具。
records.previous: Armor of fear that, when worn, clears your mind of distracting thoughts, so that you can only{j}think of annihilating the enemy before your{j}eyes.
records.target: Fearsome armor that clears the mind,{j}leaving only thoughts of annihilating the{j}enemy before your eyes.

records.source: 黄金の月の欠片で作られたか{j}と思わせる、壮麗なる女王の{j}頭装備。光こそが最たる装飾。
records.previous: Is it made from a fragment of the golden moon?{j}making you think so--the magnificent queen's{j}Head equipment. Light is the ultimate adornment.
records.target: A queen's headpiece seemingly made from a{j}golden moon fragment. Light is its finest{j}adornment.

records.source: 往古の神具を模した頭用装備。{j}数多の星霜を経た砦蟹素材は、{j}神への供物にふさわしい。
records.previous: Head gear modeled after ancient sacred implements.{j}Fortress Crab materials that have weathered countless years{j}are worthy offerings to the gods.
records.target: Head gear modeled after ancient sacred{j}implements. Aged Fortress Crab materials{j}make worthy offerings to the gods.

scope: Six exact-source melee and four head-armor description patterns.
